registered: 2026-10-31, before any model-level gate run on this host (no GGUF/reference weights existed on disk at that time)

rationale.reference_vs_engine_difference: mlx_lm's BitLinear multiplies float activations by the ternary weights; bitnet.cpp quantizes each activation row to int8 (absmax, step amax/127) before the integer dot product. The gate therefore cannot demand bit-equality. Per-element activation error is ~0.3-1 % (upstream microsoft/BitNet#586 reports 0.3-1 % per element), accumulated over 30 layers.
rationale.near_tie_margin: A top-1 flip is only excused when the reference's own top-1/top-2 gap is below max(0.25, 4*sigma), sigma being the measured RMS error of that gap in the same run (v2). sigma is capped at 10 % of the reference logit std, so scrambled/garbage engines (sigma ~ logit std) are never excused.
rationale.kl_bounds: Mean KL(ref||engine) <= 0.02 nats corresponds to <= ~2 % perplexity change; honest int8-activation noise is expected to be roughly an order of magnitude smaller. A single position may reach 0.25 nats. These are NOT calibrated on a real engine/reference pair (none existed); they are chosen to reject any real defect (wrong layout, wrong offset, SiLU vs relu^2 give KL >> 1) while tolerating the documented quantization noise.
rationale.cosine: Cosine similarity of mean-centered logits per position >= 0.99; garbage/scrambled weights give ~0.
rationale.perplexity: Q6_K embeddings change wikitext ppl by +0.17 %, Q3_K by +3.1 % (src/README.md); 2 % allows int8-activation noise and rejects visible degradation. The comparison is paired (same ids, same positions), so sampling noise of the short text cancels.
rationale.non_finite: Any NaN/Inf logit is an automatic failure.

history: v1 (commit 32fc302) used a fixed near-tie margin of 0.25 logits (a guess: ~2 sigma of an assumed 0.1 noise). The first synthetic end-to-end run (kernel fixed + relu2) measured logit noise std ~0.12 and top1-top2 margin-error std ~0.15 and failed ONE free-running greedy check (flip at reference margin 0.446 = ~3 sigma) while passing every teacher-forced and perplexity check (top-1 0.972, mean KL 0.0028, min cos 0.9993, |ln ppl ratio| 0.0197, i.e. 1.99 % against the 2 % bound - the synthetic model's perplexity (~3.7e5, above uniform) makes this check hypersensitive). v2 replaces the guess by the measured margin noise of the same run, with a hard cap so a broken engine cannot excuse itself. This change was made AFTER seeing that result; v1 outputs are kept in the evidence directory.

near_tie.comment: sigma = RMS over all teacher-forced positions of [(eng[top1_ref]-eng[top2_ref]) - (ref[top1]-ref[top2])]. A top-1 flip / greedy divergence is excused only if the reference margin < max(floor, k_sigma*sigma). The gate fails outright if sigma > 0.10 * std(reference logits).
